spring/mist images, oligos/ontos escape variation, swelling speech and freedom/slavery irony
gar transition, knowledge/escape-entanglement condition, worse-last-state inference and double proverb

lanthanei gar reply, water syntax, di hon antecedent and same-word flood/fire contrast
divine-time comparison, patience pronoun variation, day/thief image and major earth/works textual alternatives in 3:10
